title: SmartTriggers
description: Create custom triggers & automatic actions from in-game events
body:
Create powerful custom triggers based on chat, action bar, scoreboard, titles and more.
Automatically run actions like messages, titles, sounds, commands or state changes.

---

### What is SmartTriggers?
SmartTriggers is a fully client side mod, that lets you create your own automation system inside Minecraft. The Mod takes many diffrent Triggers and executes actions according to what you have set up.

The full list of Sources includes:
- Chat
- Action Bar
- Title
- Scoreboard (Sidebar)
- Tablist


The full list of Actions includes:
- Writing something in your Chat
- Setting an Action Bar
- Sending a Title
- Playing a Sound
- Executing a Command

Minecraft Formatting Codes will also work with these actions


You can also let the Mod do the following things:
- Toggling a Flag
- Starting/Stopping a Timer
- Incrementing/Resetting a Counter

Triggers can also react to these states. With these commands you can remove active states:
- /smarttriggers clear all - removes all active states
- /smarttriggers clear flags/timers/counters - removes all active flags/timers/counters
- /smarttriggers clear flags/timers/counters <key> - removes the flag/timer/counter with the specified key

---

### Configuration:
- **/smarttriggers** -> opens the main config screen
- **/smarttriggers gui** -> for moving the around the hud elements

### Example use cases:
- Show a title when a specific chat message appears
- Play a sound when something shows up in the scoreboard
- Start a Timer when someone joins your server

### Note:
- Client-side only
- Designed with Hypixel Skyblock in mind, but works on most servers and in singleplayer
- Automatic command execution actions may not be allowed on some servers

### Why this mod?
Unlike simple alert mods, SmartTriggers gives you a full rule-based system, that lets you fully customize what you want to have happen
